newsitem.title: ARGENTINA: Argentine bonds tread water ahead of FOMC.
newsitem.headline: Argentine bonds tread water ahead of FOMC.

text.p: Argentine bonds were flat late morning Monday as the market tread water ahead of Tuesday's policy-setting meeting of the U.S. Federal Open Market Committee (FOMC).
"There is nothing going on today," said a trader at a local bank.
Argentina's FRB Brady bond due 2005 was unchanged at 92-3/8, while the dollar-denominated Bocon Previsional 4 due 2002 was up flat at 115.05.
Another trader said the market had largely discounted a 25-basis point hike in the U.S. Federal funds rate.
He added that he anticipated a small rally in prices if the Federal Reserve leaves rates unchanged.
